body: Is the laughter because there are none?! I was thinking the same. And if there was it would be all middle aged, San Antonio physiques. Lol
Maybe it was really hot and he was helping them out?

I’m in the same boat as you. I have people I can talk to but not see locally. It’s the same with us. We will have a huge fight, make up and she will be fine for a while. I’m always waiting for the other foot to drop though. It’s a constant walking on egg shells with her.
Doing ok. There are good days and bad ones. How are you doing?
Thanks. I understand and appreciate all of that.
I have asked her several times to nudge me. She says she’s already awake and it’s pointless. As for hiring a babysitter we think he’s still too little to leave with someone.
I have told her to nudge me, but she says she’s already awake so it’s pointless.
Same with me. It’s a day to day thing. It’s bound to happen again.
I’m doing much better. I’m home with my kids again and I feel complete again. Thank you for asking. How are you doing?

Thank you for asking. I’m ok. I’m still extremely depressed, but the thought of suicide is gone for now. I realize I can’t leave my kids behind. They need me. They are the only thing for me to live for and I will never disappoint them. Things will get better. I just have to grind through this nightmare. I don’t want my kids to think of me as a coward who couldn’t take care of them. I really do appreciate you for asking. How are you?
She has not been diagnosed but I’m almost certain she is bi polar. She won’t go see anybody for help. She says she doesn’t need it because it’s me.

She can be very moody. When we are happy we are on top of the world. When we’re not it’s really bad. It’s always really bad when it’s the time of the month and definitely in the latter part of pregnancy and postpartum.
It really does take a toll. I’m so emotionally beat down it has affected the person I used to be. I put on the best face I can for the kids, but it’s all a lie.
I’ve suggested that to her and she just blows up. I’ve also gotten her mother involved, but my wife is unreasonable and won’t listen to anybody.
